reviews.comment: This is my third time taking Dr. Ploy and each time she has been a great professor. Her organizational skills that she has with her class makes it easy for students to succeed. The class is a decent amount of effort because of in class assignments and quizzes but if you put some effort in they aren't so bad
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Ploy was an amazing fluids professor, and I would highly recommend her to anyone taking this course.  She does a great job explaining concepts and her step-by-step solutions to example problems in the lectures really helped.  Additionally, her step-by-step solutions to the homework problems were amazing for studying for exams.

Dr. Charoenphol is the best fluids professor. Attend her office hours and she can help you with your homework and understanding practice exam problems. She is always in a good mood and will do her best to help you. If you missed the deadline to submit an ICA, you can knock on her office and explain the situation and then email your work to the TA.
Chareonphol is one of the best professors in the MEEN department at A&M, her tests are not too bad if you prepare enough for them
Absolutely the best teacher I have ever had. So clear in what she wants. Made it my easiest class.

MEEN 315 is a difficult course but Dr. Ploy makes it very doable. As long as you do all of the assignments, in class activities, and all of the practice material you can succeed in this class. She is also very understanding and reasonable.

Probably the best professor you are gonna get in MEEN. Class was very organized with all the lectures, notes, homework and exam solutions being posted to help. The grade I got is what I deserve because she does as much as she can to help you understand the material and do well. The homework took some time, but was very helpful for exam preparation.

Dr. Ploy is a great prof! Thermodynamics is a difficult course and she teaches it is a very descriptive and easy to understand way. The exams are difficult, but she makes the classwork and exams only as difficult as it needs to be for a student to understand, nothing unnecessary. Definitely recommend this class with Dr. Ploy!

The most organized professor I have had in my undergrad. She makes sure that concepts are understood and is very clear of what is expected in her class. Her exams can be pretty tricky but if you follow her teachings well enough, you can excel in this class. She is also very understanding and tries to be as helpful as possible.

She is probably one of the few best MEEN professors in the department right now. Her lectures and explanation of the material were very clear and straightforward for many students. She was always happy to clear up confusion and answer questions to make sure we were all on track. If you get the opportunity, please take her for a MEEN class.

Fantastic professor. She's super nice, happy to help and always accessible. The class is difficult but she's always there to help. Weekly homework that gets fairly time consuming but it's necessary to do well on tests not just busy work usually.
She is very nice. The tests can get difficult but she grades them nicely. Homework is all submission grade. Curved a little at the end of the semester.

Best Professor for mechanical engineers at Texas A&M, straight forward, studying hard for exams are essential as they are the extreme majority of the grade. Her lectures are required to do well in this class (even though she shares lecture notes, vocal explanation helps understand the material much better).

She responds to emails fast and is caring. I messed up a homework submission and didn't notice until 2+ weeks later, and she fixed my grade for me. Her lectures are clear and the grading structure is straightforward. Tests are kind of tough but she is still the best thermo prof in meen.

She is a good thermo professor. Her exams tend to be harder than other profs but she makes up for it by teaching more clearly. There is a slight curve at the end of the class. The quizzes are super easy, practice the homework and pay attention in class and you will do fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Not a great professor. She made thermodynamics harder than electricity and magnetism. Tests were nothing like the homework and she always pulled something out of nowhere to stump us. Ruthless with grading and wont help you out at all even to slightly bump your grade out of the 60's. She doesnt post her notes online and she does no example problems
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Charoenphol is very knowledgeable about fluids, and writes clear and neat lecture notes. The lecture quality is not so good with a large class size, but the lectures follow from the textbook. The three exams are generous in terms of difficulty. The homework is graded for completion, and the quizzes are easy.

Her lectures are really informative and if you copy down what she writes it can really help. She posts previous tests which are very very helpful. For the first test I didn't study it much and got a 75 and the next two i did the practice tests several times and got a 92. The tests have increasing weight but also build on one another.

Professor Charoenphol is definitely the best Thermo professor at TAMU. Her lectures are clear but I still went to A+ to get more help. She posts previous exams to help you prepare for the midterms. I had a B the whole time but slipped to a C due to the final. Definitely recommend her.

Exams were fair but challenging at times. She gave lots of partial credit on all assignments and exams. Quizzes in class but not too often. Really amazing notes and examples. Class was clear and easy because of her amazing teaching ability. She is a MUST for fluid dynamics.

Her thermodynamics lectures are appealing. I feel like I really learn the materials. There are some group projects (tasks) associated with the class, and they all should be fun. The exams are interesting and challenging. Take the honor section if possible, so you get more chances to ask any question after the classes. Highly recommended!

One of the most competent professors that I have had in mechanical engineering. The tests were difficult and averages were low, but there was a small curve at the end of the course. However, she teaches the material well and seems to care about her students.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Notes notes notes. Take notes in class. Final was difficult. She is happy to help.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: She is a great prof IMO, she is very clear in lecture which in upper level MEEN courses at TAMU is a tough find. The test were common exams which kind of sucked but I didnt feel unprepared for them and everything else is easy, homework is on Chegg, quizzes and project are easy, Id definately recommend her because youll at least learn Thermo.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Would take again

reviews.comment: She is a really good prof, very clear.  I never felt well prepared for the exams though. The quizzes were okay, they were based on homework. Overall, i'd say if you put forth effort, you will do great because she is in fact very good.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: super nice, have to be present for class because all the material comes from the lectures

Dr. Ploy (as she goes by) is a take-if-you-have-to professor. The tests are standardized, and she doesn't teach to them. No review guides, her lecture reviews are just summaries of "here are the things that we've done," which, if you've been taking notes, you don't need her to tell you, and if you haven't, you won't learn anything then.

Professor Charoenphol was very thorough in her lectures and prepares you for each test and quiz. As long as you do the homework, example problems and go through the lecture you will be fine. Her test and quizzes are graded fairly. Would definitely recommend.
